title: Falls apart
text: Falls apart. First the cutting wheels on the cutter broke so I threw the cutter in the trash.  And now, because the body of the unit is made from cheap plastic, it takes two or three ups and downs to get the cork out.

description: OXO SteeL Vertical Lever Corkscrew with Removable Foil Cutter,Black/Silver,2.1Don't let a stubborn cork get between you and your favorite wine. The OXO Steel Vertical Lever Corkscrew removes corks smoothly and quickly with two easy motions. The die-cast zinc handle with soft, non-slip grips provides leverage for comfortable use and the non-stick screw glides easily into cork. The cork releases from the Corkscrew with a simple pump of the lever. The removable foil cutter stores on the Corkscrew for quick access and convenient storage. The Vertical Lever Corkscrew comes with an extra screw for long-term use and is the perfect addition to any home barware collection.OXO SteeL Expanding Leakproof Wine Stopper, (2 Pack)The OXO steel leak-proof expanding wine stopper provides a perfect fit for any cork-topped bottle. The flat top allows bottles to fit on refrigerator doors or shelves, while the leak-proof seal allows bottles to be stored Lying down. The stopper seal not only helps prevents drips, but it will keep your wine fresh until you’re ready for another glass.
